policy.selection: block zero plus 15 complete blocks by SHA256(seed|select|class|block); no replacements
policy.initial_partition: 4 nonzero selected blocks by SHA256(seed|partition|class|block) are validation
policy.grouping: union same class consecutive-ID block plus exact raw/composite/all-panel/input pixel duplicates
policy.duplicate_role: train wins on mixed partition; cross-class duplicate component quarantined and blocks readiness
policy.layout: RGB single-frame PNG; empty EXIF; width divisible by 5; 64<=panel width,height<=2048; ratio 0.5..2
policy.layout_claim: structural checks plus fixed 36-record visual QA; not full-corpus semantic verification
policy.preprocessing: leftmost [0,0,width/5,height]; RGB->L->RGB; aspect-fit LANCZOS pad black to 224x224
policy.duplicate_scope: selected 1024 only; exact bytes and dimension-bound pixels, not perceptual/physical identity
policy.test_policy: metadata and archive stream headers only; never extract/decode author test or masks
policy.failures: preserve all planned rows; no replacement/retry; any failure/conflict blocks training readiness
policy.minimum_partition: each class train>=256/validation>=64 and each role>=2 final groups; else blocked
policy.qa_selection: both previously exposed records plus record16 of each selected32 block, per class; 8 validation records exposed only to layout QA
policy.license: author CC BY-NC-SA 4.0; conflicting Figshare CC BY metadata unresolved; local noncommercial research
policy.old51: exposed development stress regression only; no tuning on new LOCO24

training.initialization: existing original COCO Faster R-CNN MobileNetV3 strict state, then backbone.body only
training.feature: body output key 1 (960 channels), global adaptive average pool
training.head: Linear(960,2), only head trainable; backbone eval including normalization
training.selection: final epoch 10 only; no best-epoch/threshold search
training.confidence_claim: softmax is not calibrated correctness or open-set confidence

component_gate.scope: continuation gate only, no production promotion

proposal_interface.recall_evaluation: one-to-one IoU>=0.5 against author target boxes on exposed development source groups
proposal_interface.limitations: LOCO lacks author instance boxes; any added labels require separate provenance/QA
proposal_interface.integration: not implemented; conflict may only become unknown, never auto-correct/add counts
